_note: Every value is tagged. ASSUMED = illustrative, must be replaced with insurer data. MEASURED = produced by our code on the named file.

minutes_routine_confirm_per_claim.basis: time to confirm a system routine recommendation

minutes_request_info_per_claim.basis: time to draft an information request

minutes_recheck_per_affected_claim.basis: time to re-review one open claim after a rule change

open_claims_share.basis: share of claims open at any time

routine_share_of_claims.basis: set from run.py v1 mix on the named file at run time

wrong_routine_error_cost_eur.basis: illustrative leakage per wrong routine decision

proxy_flip_share_at_v2.basis: set from replay on synthetic file at run time
